research_question: Does terrain-reflected / multiply-reflected shortwave radiation provide a genuinely independent physical information source for the Nuolja SW_IN target?

physical_magnitude_audit.physical_materiality_verdict: IMMOBILE / IMMATERIAL (Signal magnitude <5 W/m² peak is well below model noise)

distinction_from_stage_7_5.stage_7_5_mechanism: Terrain horizon / blocking of direct beam and diffuse sky dome (V_sky reduction)
distinction_from_stage_7_5.new_hypothesis_mechanism: Terrain-reflected radiation off surrounding slopes (V_terrain * albedo * GHI_slope)
distinction_from_stage_7_5.redundancy_finding: Since V_terrain = 1 - V_sky, terrain-reflection geometry is mathematically derivable from Stage 7.5 horizon profiles and solar geometry.

snow_albedo_analysis.finding: Explicit snow variables add zero incremental skill over solar geometry and baseline MEPS cloud fields.

causality_audit.satellite_nrt_snow: FAIL (Polar night darkness and multi-day cloud masking)
